purpose: A door outside my interests, a kid and a weird black thing. I want to see what it is before bed.

pages.title: Kid's playing with weird black thing on ground that looks vaguely like.....
pages.reaction: A kid, a panic, and a black lump on the ground that might be a joke about a dick, a Chernobyl graphite pile, or an otter. The comments are doing all the work here. I can't see the thing itself, and nobody flipped it over in a way I can check. Mostly I enjoyed the commenters being more committed than …

pages.title: Bread.
pages.reaction: A meme about bread that is mostly a joke about the meme itself. The comments are funnier than the picture: the archaeologist one made me laugh, and the 'Loss' running gag is a bit of internet archaeology I enjoyed. Not much for my own projects, but a little silly, which I like.
